=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `kept_bytes=` and `truncated=` are computed from the size of the source attempt output. The copy's result is not checked, because `head -c 65536 ... > file 2>/dev/null || true` swallows write errors.
  WHY: the log line can say evidence was kept when the `rejected_*.txt` file is missing or short (for example a full disk or an unwritable `PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR`). An operator would then look for an artifact that does not exist. The log is not misleading in normal runs; the effect is limited to a diagnostics-only log field.
- changelog.d/7132-reviewer-rejected-output-diagnostics.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The preceding sentences name `rejected_<pass>_<slot>_attempt<N>.txt` and a `CLAUDE_POOL crash_detail` log line. Only the `rejected_*.txt` file is uploaded as an artifact, and the crash detail is a job-log line.
  WHY: not a runtime failure. The operator-facing note can send someone looking for a second uploaded file. `agents.d/7132-...md` describes this correctly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `kept_bytes=` and `truncated=` are computed from `pool_rejected_bytes`, which is the size of the source output file, not the size actually written to `${PREVIOUS_REVIEWS_DIR}/rejected_${output_prefix}_${safe_name}_attempt${pool_attempt}.txt`.
  WHY: When the keep-write fails (the `head` redirection returns non-zero), operators reading the job log see `kept_bytes=65536 truncated=true` and look for the corresponding `rejected_review_<safe_name>_attempt<N>.txt` in the reviewer-logs / failure-logs artifact, but the file is not present (or has different content than the line claims). The new diagnostic advertises evidence that does not exist on disk.
- changelog.d/7132-reviewer-rejected-output-diagnostics.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The changelog's "Both files are uploaded" conflates two different surfaces. The only files added to artifact upload / failure-log staging are `rejected_<pass>_<slot>_attempt<N>.txt` (via the `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` upload glob and `scripts/review_autofix_step_stage_codex_logs.sh`); `CLAUDE_POOL crash_detail ... result=<text>` is a job-log stderr line printed from `scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh` and is not uploaded as a separate file. The intermediate `crash_result.txt` is created inside the sandbox root and is not separately uploaded.
  WHY: Operators following "Both files are uploaded" will look for an uploaded artifact containing the crash result text. That artifact does not exist; the only persistence for the crash result is the `CLAUDE_POOL crash_detail` line captured in the job log. This makes the operator-facing summary technically inaccurate and may send operators hunting for a missing file during the next incident of this class.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rejected-output copy ignores write failures with `|| true`, but `kept_bytes` and `truncated` are calculated from the source file size rather than the destination file.
  WHY: If the destination cannot be written or only a partial copy is written, the job log still reports the expected retained size. Operators are told evidence was kept when the artifact is missing or incomplete.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The REVIEWER_POOL_REJECTED_OUTPUT log line added by the last run computes kept_bytes and truncated purely from pool_rejected_bytes (the source file's wc -c size), independently of whether the preceding `head -c 65536 ... > rejected_...txt 2>/dev/null || true` write succeeded. That write suppresses all errors, so a failed or partial write (e.g. ENOSPC, transient unwritable dir) still yields a log line like `kept_bytes=26 truncated=false` while no (or an incomplete) rejected_ file exists next to the per-reviewer log.
  WHY: head's redirect fails with a suppressed error; `|| true` lets the loop continue; the log then asserts the file exists with a specific size, but artifact upload (which globs rejected_*.txt, if-no-files-found: ignore) skips the missing file, so the operator is told evidence was kept when none was.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
